what: speech-to-text on Bhojpuri: RESPIN test set (IISc, CC-BY-4.0, mirror rimrafadii/respin-iisc @ 9460f60f2541, split bh), 120 utterances = 12 at each of 10 evenly spaced offsets of the sorted file list; the *_60 columns are the 60 utterances at every other offset
normalisation: NFC, punctuation and symbols removed (combining marks kept), lower case, whitespace collapsed
conditions: 2 threads, shared 4-vCPU x86_64, no GPU, other jobs running

rows.label: whisper-small-bhojpuri
rows.model: Aditya109/whisper-small-bhojpuri-merged @ d39a21ba0f59, converted to CTranslate2 int8 here (tools/voices/convert_whisper.py), decoded with language hi

note: An earlier run of this evaluation used a normaliser that split Devanagari vowel signs off their letters; it was discarded. The research note's 40.2 % / 13.8 % for the Hindi model was on a different 60-utterance selection.
